regarding the subject in this case. The subject was identified through an online chat forum
known for pedophiles and those sharing child sexual abuse materials. The crux of the report was

members for sex.


There was an additional arrest made connecting to the Jeffrey Epstein case. July 2 Ghilane
Maxwell was arrested, and VS           is coordinating victim notification with SDNY.
